snippet.title: Terminal  - Official Trailer (60s)
snippet.description:
Official trailer for Terminal, a psychological horror interactive fiction story.

You are alone inside the terminal window of Tera, a 30-year-old designer on a cold Illinois night. An unknown presence has taken control, threatening to expose her most private thoughts and memories. Your inputs are all that can protect the fragile wiring that holds together her identity and self.
